_metadata.description: Product-roadmap example user complaints, recorded verbatim for assessment. These are ILLUSTRATIONS OF USER LANGUAGE, not proposed mappings. No canonical token is assigned to any of them here.

provenance.product_source: Approved WellaPath MVP Improvement Roadmap, supplied to the engineering process and carried into the I2 / W2 Step 5 brief.
provenance.note: These are product examples with an identified product source: they appear in the approved MVP Improvement Roadmap provided to the engineering process. What they lack is repository-level provenance for any CLINICAL MAPPING — a search of this repository found no committed document containing them, and no clinician has mapped any of them to a token. They are therefore product examples only, not clinically approved mappings, and they remain unresolved evidence gaps. They are not source-less; the roadmap is their source. No canonical token is assigned to any of them here.
searched: *.md and *.json across the repository at 550e8f17 — no committed copy of these strings

_metadata.handling_rule: Each example is assessed for candidate tokens, lost context and ambiguity. None may be assigned a canonical token without evidence and explicit clinical + product review. An example that cannot be mapped safely stays an identified content gap.
